WITH RECURSIVE data_points AS (
  SELECT 1 AS id,
         CASE abs(random() % 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'Group A' WHEN 1 THEN 'Group B' ELSE 'Group C' END AS category,
         abs(random() % 100) + 20 AS value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id + 1,
         CASE abs(random() % 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'Group A' WHEN 1 THEN 'Group B' ELSE 'Group C' END,
         abs(random() % 100) + 20
  FROM data_points
  WHERE id < 30
)
SELECT category, value FROM data_points
